name: catalyst_r2e_lambdarank_fusion_v1
purpose: Replace hand-tuned score weights/threshold combinations with an automatically selected LambdaMART-style candidate reranker over the two independently validated R2E model families, while preserving the confirmed sim<0.9 production router as the exact tail fallback.
method_precedent: two-stage multi-retriever candidate generation plus learned LambdaRank/LambdaMART reranking; implemented with the repository's existing XGBoost rank:ndcg stacker rather than a new handwritten optimizer

reranker.binary_relevance: known dev positive protein=1, all shortlist negatives=0
reranker.candidate_pool: union of top pool_k candidates from both source models
reranker.output_semantics: promote exactly prefix_k learned candidates, then append the exact current-router full ordering with promoted candidates removed; therefore every non-promoted tail pair retains its relative fallback order

automatic_search.cross_validation: for every configuration, train on two development folds and evaluate the third; aggregate exactly one OOF prediction per query across folds 0/1/2

selection_constraints.selection_score: geometric mean of candidate/current-router ratios for MRR, MAP, NDCG@10 and Hit@10 among constraint-satisfying configurations; tie break Hit@50 ratio then lexical config id
selection_constraints.confirmation_material_gate: primary geometric-mean relative gain >= 1.005 and at least one of MRR +0.003 absolute, MAP +0.003 absolute, or Hit@10 +0.01 absolute
selection_constraints.auroc_semantics: Within this learned-reranker family, both current-router baseline and candidate use AUROC derived from the same deterministic full candidate ordering / exact positive ranks. Do not mix the historical score-tie averaged AUROC with the rank-only reranker output.

confirmation.ranker_training_before_confirmation: fit the frozen selected configuration on all OOF development query groups only
confirmation.promotion_gate: MRR, MAP, AUROC, NDCG@10, Hit@10, Hit@20 and Hit@50 all >= the matched frozen current-router baseline; MRR/MAP/NDCG@10/Hit@10 geometric-mean ratio > 1; retain the development material threshold on at least one of MRR/MAP/Hit@10
